platform_note: Linux rerun of the comparison. The Windows run is unfair to LiteLLM because uvloop does not exist on Windows and litellm 1.95.0 explicitly requests it on every other platform.

hardware.note: k6, three llmsim instances, penstock and litellm all ran on this one machine and competed for these cores

toolchain.go: binaries cross compiled with go1.26.5 windows/amd64, GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0

penstock.note: unmodified bench/config/gateway.yaml, the same file its own flagship benchmark uses

litellm.deps: uvicorn==0.52.1, fastapi==0.139.2, httptools==0.8.0, uvloop==0.22.1, orjson==3.11.9, pydantic==2.13.4, gunicorn==23.0.0
litellm.event_loop: uvloop, requested by litellm proxy_cli._get_loop_type() on non-Windows
litellm.steelman: LITELLM_MODE=PRODUCTION, LITELLM_LOG=ERROR, telemetry off, local model cost map, json_logs, set_verbose false, no database, no redis, no callbacks, no guardrails, no cache, store_model_in_db false
litellm.handicaps_lifted_versus_windows: uvloop present and in use; gunicorn importable

upstream.instances: three, identically seeded: one for the baseline, one behind penstock, one behind litellm
